capabilities: Show a folder as a Gantt table and timeline
Reschedule and resize tasks by dragging bars
Show tasks as a Kanban board by status
extras: Google Calendar sync is desktop-only and uses your own Google Cloud project; notifications fire only while Obsidian is running. No CSV import, and auto-scheduling, sub-day granularity and cross-folder aggregation are not implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timeline or status board for notes, so planning tasks kept as notes means editing frontmatter dates by hand.

relations.evidence: over the days, like ClickUp, with weekends hatched

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret
Discord, Slack or Microsoft Teams webhook

summary: Folder-based Gantt and Kanban board where each Markdown note is a task, with draggable bars, dependencies, filters and saved views.
